dedupe_keys.name: public transport journeys by type of transport

description: Public Transport Journeys by Type of Transport is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Number of journeys on the public transport network by TFL reporting period, by type of transport. Data is broken down by bus, underground, DLR, tram, Overground and cable car. Period lengths are different in periods 1 and 13, and the data is not adjusted to account for that. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
